budget: No Anthropic spend: pages by direct curl, the keyless reader proxy (two calls, both DNS failures), and Claude Code web search to find funder domains and CVS bulletins. The overnight verify read will stamp _page_read on the 31 staged rows (about 31 production-key reads, approved by Paul 24 Sept). No Vercel build.
dedup: Full read of scraped_grants, 2,223 rows, count asserted equal to the table count before any comparison. Each candidate checked by funder name, title and apply URL (regex over funder, title and URL); the stage script re-checks normalised URL and exact title and refuses a partial read. Dedup against the London boroughs batch via its results file (Cripplegate, City Bridge, Trust for London strands).
scoring_method: Same gates the dashboard applies (funding type, legal structure, sector intersection, location text) then computeMatchScore; 55 is a match. Every org has an income band set and two names have duplicate records, so every record is scored and a row counts once per org if any record clears 55. Canaries: a Colchester theatre fund must score 55+ for Mercury Theatre (88), and must be stopped by the location gate when tagged Cardiff and by the structure gate when CIC-only; all three held. Second derivation: re-scored from the grants_with_funder view after staging. Every gate agreed; every numeric score was exactly +3 higher, which is the matcher's freshness bonus for rows under three days old (+2 to day 7, +1 to day 14, 0 after). The steady-state numbers are headline; one verdict differs while fresh (Tarmac for Bikeworks, 54 steady, 57 fresh).
